notes: 构建管线收敛到 aibox-tsbuild：产物从单个 app.js 换成与源码 1:1 的多文件 ESM，排障时设备上的文件与仓库源码对得上。运行时形态不变（仍是预构建 bundle，端上零转译），功能与界面无改动。

localizedNotes.en: Build pipeline converged onto aibox-tsbuild: the bundle is now structure-preserving multi-file ESM that maps 1:1 to the sources instead of a single app.js. Runtime shape is unchanged (still a prebuilt bundle, zero on-device transpilation); no functional or UI changes.

manifest.name: 单词学习
manifest.summary: 查词、翻译、生词本与 Leitner 复习

localizedSummaries.en: Dictionary lookup, translation, vocabulary and Leitner review

actions.name: word_lookup
actions.summary: Looks up an English word or short phrase: phonetics (UK/US IPA), part-of-speech senses, inflected forms, example sentences, exam tags (CET-4/6, postgrad, etc.), synonyms/antonyms, and a memory tip. Cached lookups return instantly; a new word is scraped from a dictionary site and falls back to a one-shot AI generation (may take a few seconds). Accepts a spelling-corrected suggestion if the input looks misspelled.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"term":{"type":"string","description":"The English word or short phrase to look up."}},"required":["term"],"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: word_translate
actions.summary: Translates text between Chinese and English (auto-detects direction by default: CJK input → Chinese-to-English, otherwise English-to-Chinese). Returns translation only, no explanation. Pass 'direction' to force a specific direction instead of auto-detection.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string","description":"The text to translate (up to 3000 characters)."},"direction":{"type":"string","enum":["auto","zhToEn","enToZh"],"description":"Translation direction; defaults to 'auto' (detect by script)."}},"required":["text"],"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: word_list_vocab
actions.summary: Lists the user's saved vocabulary (words and saved sentences), most recently added first. Filter by kind or mastered status, and/or search by a text fragment matched against the term and its brief gloss. Read-only, local data — no AI call, no network.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"filter":{"type":"string","enum":["all","word","sentence","mastered","unmastered"],"description":"Restrict the list to this kind/status; defaults to 'all'."},"query":{"type":"string","description":"Optional fuzzy text to match against term or gloss."},"limit":{"type":"integer","description":"Max items to return (default 50, max 200)."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: word_vocab_upsert
actions.summary: Adds a word or sentence to the user's saved vocabulary, or updates its mastered flag if it's already saved. Non-destructive — never deletes existing data. Use word_lookup first if you need the word's brief gloss cached alongside it.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"term":{"type":"string","description":"The word or sentence text to save."},"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["word","sentence"],"description":"What kind of entry this is; defaults to 'word'."},"mastered":{"type":"boolean","description":"Mark as mastered (archived, out of review pool)."}},"required":["term"],"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: word_vocab_remove
actions.summary: Permanently removes a word or sentence from the user's saved vocabulary. This cannot be undone — confirm with the user before calling unless they explicitly asked to delete it.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"term":{"type":"string","description":"The exact word or sentence text to remove."}},"required":["term"],"additionalProperties":false}

    // 错误
    errNoProvider: { zh: '所选模型未配置 AI 服务商。', en: 'No AI provider is configured for the selected model.' },

};
/** 取一条文案，可选插值 `{n}`。 */
export function makeT(lang) {
    return (key, params) => {
        let value = TABLE[key][lang];
        if (params) {
            for (const [name, replacement] of Object.entries(params)) {
                value = value.split(`{${name}}`).join(String(replacement));
            }
        }
        return value;
    };
}
/** 复习提醒条：英文有 one/other 复数，中文只有 other。 */
export function dueBanner(t, lang, count) {
    if (lang === 'en' && count === 1)
        return t('reviewBannerOne');
    return t('reviewBannerOther', { n: count });
}
/** 来源名映射（规格 §3.2）。 */
export function sourceLabel(t, source) {
    if (source === 'youdao')
        return t('sourceYoudao');
    if (!source || source === 'ai')
        return t('sourceAI');
    return t('sourceOther');
}
